title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE PHILIPPINE AMUSEMENT AND GAMING CORPORATION (PAGCOR) FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE
title.orig: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE PHILIPPINE AMUSEMENT AND GAMING CORPORATION (PAGCOR) FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE

text.en:
The Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation is hereby
transferred from the Office of the President and attached to the Department of Finance.

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 16th day of July in the year of our Lord, two
thousand and four.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
